disclaimer_text:
Gym24 gives general fitness and nutrition guidance. It is not medical advice and does not replace a doctor, physiotherapist or registered dietitian.
Consult a qualified professional before starting a new training or nutrition plan, especially if you have a medical condition, injury, eating disorder history, or are under 18, pregnant or taking medication.
Stop exercising and seek help if you feel pain, dizziness or chest discomfort.
